❗️BREAKING❗️

Schools in China Closed as HMPV Infections Surge; WHO Demands Detailed Information on Outbreak.

Schools in Wuhan, China, have been closed amid a rise in HMPV infections. 

WHO expresses concern and seeks detailed information
